info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Wholesale Trading Market Making-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation of market-making specifications within the wholesale trading environment. It allows users to define and submit detailed parameters related to market-making activities, enhancing liquidity and trading efficiency. Typical consumers include financial institutions and trading firms seeking to optimize their trading strategies. By leveraging this API, organizations can automate their market-making processes and respond rapidly to market changes.

post.summary: Create a new market making order.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a market making order in the wholesale trading system. It supports various parameters to customize the order based on trading strategies and market conditions.
